content.comment_body: I'm splitting my previous discussion into smaller parts for clarity. The included file compares readings from two PT100 sensors: when T1 is greater than T2, Q3 activates; when T1 is less than T2, Q2 activates. Currently, if T1 equals T2, no output is generated. I want Q3 to activate when T1 is greater than or equal to T2, ensuring there’s always an active output. Any advice?
Hello [user_name], Take a look here: How can you use [product_name] to compare two analog values? Best regards [user_name]
